parameters.jsCode:
// Format per-trade email const data = $json; const result = data.trade_result || data.result || 'PENDING'; const isWin = result === 'WIN'; const emoji = isWin ? '✅' : (result === 'LOSS' ? '❌' : '⏳'); const subject = `${emoji} Trade ${result}: ${data.asset || 'UNKNOWN'} ${data.direction || ''}`; const html = `

${emoji} Trade ${result}

Timestamp: ${data.timestamp || new Date().toISOString()}

Trade Details

Asset: ${data.asset || 'UNKNOWN'}
Direction: ${data.direction || data.action || 'UNKNOWN'}
Amount: $${(data.amount || 0).toFixed(2)}
Duration: ${data.duration || 0} min
Result: ${result}
Payout: ${(data.payout || 0) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}$${(data.payout || 0).toFixed(2)}

AI Consensus

Confidence: ${(data.confidence || data.ai_confidence || 0).toFixed(1)}%
Consensus: ${data.consensus_reached ? 'Yes' : 'No'}
${data.model_votes ? `
Model Votes: 
${JSON.stringify(data.model_votes, null, 2)}
` : ''}

🤖 IQOption AI Trading System | Generated at ${new Date().toISOString()}

This is an automated notification. Do not reply to this email.

`; return [{ json: { subject: subject, html: html, email_to: $env.N8N_EMAIL_TO || data.email_to, trade_data: data } }];

parameters.query:
=SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_trades,
  SUM(CASE WHEN trade_result = 'WIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wins,
  SUM(CASE WHEN trade_result = 'LOSS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as losses,
  SUM(payout) as total_profit,
  AVG(ai_confidence) as avg_confidence
FROM trades
WHERE DATE(timestamp) = CURRENT_DATE;
